subject: Is it possible to read in tabix files previously generated?

messages.author: 6301499b94200bcc
messages.subject: Is it possible to read in tabix files previously generated?
parts:
I was successfully reading in my correctly formatted meth call files for 17 samples (WGBS so large files), and I was 12/17 read in when an error occurred and the methRead function started to produce an error along the lines of this: 'error in "13th_file_name": "1st column" command not found' - I believe this was due to a space typo in the 13th file name. I'm sorry that I did not save the actual error.

 Anyways, my question is, if 12 samples are were already correctly compressed and had a tabix file made. Is there any way to read in these compressed or tabix files, instead of re-reading in them all from the original uncompressed files?

messages.author: a413e6cf6c4ea2cc
messages.subject: Re: Is it possible to read in tabix files previously generated?
parts:
So basically your request to read tabix files is already included in methylKit. If you use dbtype ="tabix" with the methRead function it internally checks wether this file is already a tabix file and if true, it links the methylRawDB objects to the tabix file.
 But you can not merge compressed and uncompressed files in methRead, so my idea would be to process your remaining (uncompressed) files and afterwards pass all together to the function.

Check the code below to get an idea about reading compressed files:  


library(methylKit)


# I have two files, one is already processed, the other not
compr.file.path <- system.file("extdata", "test1.txt.bgz", package = "methylKit")
uncompr.file.path <- system.file("extdata","test1.myCpG.txt",package = "methylKit")

# the compressed can be directly loaded by using the path to the database file
myobj.db <- methRead(location = compr.file.path,sample.id = "test1",assembly = "hg18")
# you need to take care of the dbtype parameter ( is NA by default)
myobj.db <- methRead(location = compr.file.path,sample.id = "test1",assembly = "hg18",dbtype = "tabix")

# the uncompressed needs to be processed before
myobj2.db <- methRead(location = uncompr.file.path,sample.id = "test1",assembly = "hg18",dbtype = "tabix")


# merging uncompressed and compressed files will lead to error
myobj.list.db <- methRead(location = list(compr.file.path,uncompr.file.path),sample.id = list("test1","test2"),treatment = c(1,1),assembly = "hg18",dbtype = "tabix")

# you have to process uncompressed files beforehand and can than load them together
myobj2.list.db <- methRead(location = list(compr.file.path,myobj2.db@dbpath),sample.id = list("test1","test2"),treatment = c(1,1),assembly = "hg18",dbtype = "tabix")

Best,

Alex
